title: Episode 06 — Ksenia Anokhina
subtitle: Ksenia Anokhina
synopsis: Ksenia Anokhina’s work looks at the relationship between new technologies, power and bureaucracy — their codes and patterns, and their ethical weight on individual and social life.
Moscow-born and based in the Netherlands for her studies, she spent three months at Hectolitre collaborating with Deborah Levy and Claire Williams on an ongoing research project.
